title: Design prompts with explicit criteria to improve precision and reduce false positives
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: The importance of explicit criteria over vague instructions (e.g., " fl ag comments only when claimed behavior contradicts actual code behavior" vs "check that comments are accurate")
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13: chỉ flag comment khi claimed behavior trái code.

knowledge.item: How general instructions like "be conservative" or "only report high-con fi dence fi ndings" fail to improve precision compared to speci fi c categorical criteria
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13: be conservative/high confidence không thay categorical criteria.

knowledge.item: The impact of false positive rates on developer trust: high false positive categories undermine con fi dence in accurate categories
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13/17: nhiễu một nhóm làm mất trust nhóm đúng.

skills.item: Writing speci fi c review criteria that de fi ne which issues to report (bugs, security) versus skip (minor style, local patterns) rather than relying on con fi dence-based fi ltering
skills.evidence: EXAM13 Q1: report bug/security, skip style/local acceptable patterns.

skills.item: Temporarily disabling high false-positive categories to restore developer trust while improving prompts for those categories
skills.evidence: EXAM13/17Q2: tạm disable category nhiễu trong khi cải tiến.

skills.item: De fi ning explicit severity criteria with concrete code examples for each severity level to achieve consistent classi fi cation
skills.evidence: EXAM13: severity theo tác động, ví dụ tenant leak/null crash/style skip và output cụ thể.

title: Apply few-shot prompting to improve output consistency and quality
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Few-shot examples as the most effective technique for achieving consistently formatted, actionable output when detailed instructions alone produce inconsistent results
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13/API14: examples khi instructions vẫn không nhất quán.

knowledge.item: The role of few-shot examples in demonstrating ambiguous-case handling (e.g., tool selection for ambiguous requests, branch-level test coverage gaps)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13: ca mơ hồ, guard hợp lệ so với null bug.

knowledge.item: How few-shot examples enable the model to generalize judgment to novel patterns rather than matching only pre-speci fi ed cases
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13: áp nguyên tắc lên ca mới, không chỉ match mẫu.

knowledge.item: The effectiveness of few-shot examples for reducing hallucination in extraction tasks (e.g., handling informal measurements, varied document structures)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM13: extraction có inline/bibliography/embedded methodology/đơn vị không trang trọng.

skills.item: Creating 2-4 targeted few-shot examples for ambiguous scenarios that show reasoning for why one action was chosen over plausible alternatives
skills.evidence: EXAM13: 2–4 targeted examples, lý do chọn hơn alternative.

skills.item: Including few-shot examples that demonstrate speci fi c desired output format (location, issue, severity, suggested fi x) to achieve consistency
skills.evidence: EXAM13: file/location/issue/severity/suggested fix.

skills.item: Providing few-shot examples distinguishing acceptable code patterns from genuine issues to reduce false positives while enabling generalization
skills.evidence: EXAM13: guarded dereference hợp lệ khác null crash tái hiện.

skills.item: Using few-shot examples to demonstrate correct handling of varied document structures (inline citations vs bibliographies, methodology sections vs embedded details)
skills.evidence: EXAM13: cấu trúc citation và methodology khác nhau.

skills.item: Adding few-shot examples showing correct extraction from documents with varied formats to address empty/null extraction of required fi elds
skills.evidence: EXAM17Q1: ví dụ extraction varied layout khi field có trong nguồn nhưng bị null.

title: Enforce structured output using tool use and JSON schemas
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Tool use (tool_use) with JSON schemas as the most reliable approach for guaranteed schema- compliant structured output, eliminating JSON syntax errors
knowledge.evidence: EXAM05: extraction schema/tool-use input, phân biệt contract thông thường với strict support thật.

knowledge.item: The distinction between tool_choice: "auto" (model may return text instead of calling a tool), "any" (model must call a tool but can choose which), and forced tool selection (model must call a speci fi c named tool)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM05/11: auto/any/forced-name.

knowledge.item: That strict JSON schemas via tool use eliminate syntax errors but do not prevent semantic errors (e.g., line items that don't sum to total, values in wrong fi elds)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM05Q2: schema hợp lệ vẫn có semantic error tổng/nhầm trường.

knowledge.item: Schema design considerations: required vs optional fi elds, enum fi elds with "other" + detail string patterns for extensible categories
knowledge.evidence: EXAM05Q3: required/optional/null và other+detail.

skills.item: De fi ning extraction tools with JSON schemas as input parameters and extracting structured data from the tool_use response
skills.evidence: EXAM05: tool schema rồi lấy dữ liệu tool_use input.

skills.item: Setting tool_choice: "any" to guarantee structured output when multiple extraction schemas exist and the document type is unknown
skills.evidence: EXAM05: any khi nhiều extraction schemas/document type chưa rõ.

skills.item: Forcing a speci fi c tool with tool_choice: {"type": "tool", "name": "extract_metadata"} to ensure a particular extraction runs before enrichment steps
skills.evidence: EXAM05/15Q1: forced metadata trước enrichment theo turn/gate.

skills.item: Designing schema fi elds as optional (nullable) when source documents may not contain the information, preventing the model from fabricating values to satisfy required fi elds
skills.evidence: EXAM05Q3: optional khác nullable, thiếu dữ liệu không bịa.

skills.item: Adding enum values like "unclear" for ambiguous cases and "other" + detail fi elds for extensible categorization
skills.evidence: EXAM05: unclear/other và detail cho ambiguity/extensibility.

skills.item: Including format normalization rules in prompts alongside strict output schemas to handle inconsistent source formatting
skills.evidence: EXAM05: normalization format trong prompt cùng schema và business validation.

title: Implement validation, retry, and feedback loops for extraction quality
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Retry-with-error-feedback: appending speci fi c validation errors to the prompt on retry to guide the model toward correction
knowledge.evidence: EXAM06Q1: retry kèm lỗi cụ thể.

knowledge.item: The limits of retry: retries are ineffective when the required information is simply absent from the source document (vs format or structural errors)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM06Q2: retry không tạo thông tin ở phụ lục chưa cung cấp.

knowledge.item: Feedback loop design: tracking which code constructs trigger fi ndings (detected_pattern fi eld) to enable systematic analysis of dismissal patterns
knowledge.evidence: EXAM06: detected_pattern phân tích dismissal.

knowledge.item: The difference between semantic validation errors (values don't sum, wrong fi eld placement) and schema syntax errors (eliminated by tool use)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM06: semantic validation khác cú pháp/schema.

skills.item: Implementing follow-up requests that include the original document, the failed extraction, and speci fi c validation errors for model self-correction
skills.evidence: EXAM06Q1: original document+failed extraction+specific errors.

skills.item: Identifying when retries will be ineffective (e.g., information exists only in an external document not provided) versus when they will succeed (format mismatches, structural output errors)
skills.evidence: EXAM06Q2: bổ sung nguồn hoặc missing/review khi thông tin vắng.

skills.item: Adding detected_pattern fi elds to structured fi ndings to enable analysis of false positive patterns when developers dismiss fi ndings
skills.evidence: EXAM06: detected_pattern trong structured findings để xem false positives.

skills.item: Designing self-correction validation fl ows: extracting "calculated_total" alongside "stated_total" to fl ag discrepancies, adding "con fl ict_detected" booleans for inconsistent source data
skills.evidence: EXAM06Q3: stated_total/calculated_total/conflict_detected riêng, không ghi đè mâu thuẫn.

title: Design ef fi cient batch processing strategies
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: The Message Batches API: 50% cost savings, up to 24-hour processing window, no guaranteed latency SLA
knowledge.evidence: EXAM07: 50%/24giờ theo guide, không coi báo giá/SLA hiện hành đã xác minh.

knowledge.item: Batch processing is appropriate for non-blocking, latency-tolerant workloads (overnight reports, weekly audits, nightly test generation) and inappropriate for blocking work fl ows (pre-merge checks)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM07Q1: latency-tolerant khác blocking pre-merge.

knowledge.item: The batch API does not support multi-turn tool calling within a single request (cannot execute tools mid-request and return results)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM07Q3: không có host-executed multiturn tools trong một request.

knowledge.item: custom_id fi elds for correlating batch request/response pairs
knowledge.evidence: EXAM07: custom_id ghép kết quả, không theo vị trí.

skills.item: Matching API approach to work fl ow latency requirements: synchronous API for blocking pre-merge checks, batch API for overnight/weekly analysis
skills.evidence: EXAM07Q1: realtime cho blocking, batch cho overnight.

skills.item: Calculating batch submission frequency based on SLA constraints (e.g., 4-hour windows to guarantee 30-hour SLA with 24-hour batch processing)
skills.evidence: EXAM07/17Q3: wait+processing,4giờ có đệm theo giả định.

skills.item: Handling batch failures: resubmitting only failed documents (identi fi ed by custom_id) with appropriate modi fi cations (e.g., chunking documents that exceeded context limits)
skills.evidence: EXAM07Q2: chỉ resubmit failed IDs, sửa nguyên nhân quá dài.

skills.item: Using prompt re fi nement on a sample set before batch-processing large volumes to maximize fi rst- pass success rates and reduce iterative resubmission costs
skills.evidence: EXAM07: refine prompt trên sample trước xử lý lớn.

title: Design multi-instance and multi-pass review architectures
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Self-review limitations: a model retains reasoning context from generation, making it less likely to question its own decisions in the same session
knowledge.evidence: EXAM08: self-review giữ giả định của generator.

knowledge.item: Independent review instances (without prior reasoning context) are more effective at catching subtle issues than self-review instructions or extended thinking
knowledge.evidence: EXAM08: reviewer context độc lập khác yêu cầu tự phản biện/thinking.

knowledge.item: Multi-pass review: splitting large reviews into per- fi le local analysis passes plus cross- fi le integration passes to avoid attention dilution and contradictory fi ndings
knowledge.evidence: EXAM08Q1/Q3: per-file + integration tránh mất độ sâu/cross-file bugs.

skills.item: Using a second independent Claude instance to review generated code without the generator's reasoning context
skills.evidence: EXAM08Q2: independent instance nhận requirements/code, không generator reasoning.

skills.item: Splitting large multi- fi le reviews into focused per- fi le passes for local issues plus separate integration passes for cross- fi le data fl ow analysis
skills.evidence: EXAM08Q1/Q3: local và cross-file data-flow pass.

skills.item: Running veri fi cation passes where the model self-reports con fi dence alongside each fi nding to enable calibrated review routing
skills.evidence: EXAM08: verification pass tự báo confidence từng finding, hiệu chỉnh với labels trước routing.
